result.title: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflows via Semantic Decomposition of Complex Tasks
result.comment: Accepted as a Spotlight at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB), GLEE Competition Track; 1st place in the GLEE competition. 21 pages
result.summary: Agentic workflows organize complex tasks into reusable procedures. However, invoking an LLM at every step incurs repeated inference costs and delays. We propose a framework for self-evolving agentic workflows through semantic task decomposition. Each subtask has explicit applicability conditions and a procedure that executes code or invokes a model as needed. An agent uses execution feedback to refine the decomposition and update these procedures. Experiments in the GLEE competition show the framework on bargaining, negotiation and persuasion. Most observed final-decision procedures are implemented in code. Code is available at https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/NeurIPS2026_SeaFlow.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出一种自演化 agentic workflow 框架：将复杂任务按语义分解为带显式适用条件的子任务，每个子任务由代码或模型调用执行，并利用执行反馈迭代改进分解与流程；在 GLEE 竞赛的谈判、议价与说服任务上验证，多数最终决策步骤由代码实现。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但其「适用条件 + 代码或模型路由」的分解方式可供核查是否能为 LVR 的按需计算、模块化状态组织与何时调用的决策提供结构线索。
